program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((cols1 (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g 0 c) 1)) (range 0 (cols g))))
         (rows2 (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r 0) 2)) (range 0 (rows g)))))
    (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)
                 (apply append (map (lambda (r) (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) cols1)) rows2))
                 3)))
